app.name: Virgule
app.description: Plan and decide together: everyone suggests, everyone votes, we keep the best ideas.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The page couldn't be displayed. Try again: most of the time, that's enough.
errorPage.roomBody: Ideas already suggested and votes already cast are saved. Try again in a moment.

home.title: Every idea, <hl>one shared decision.</hl>
home.subtitle: Up to {max} participants, one link to share, no account to create.
home.formHint: You're hosting: you pick the topics and move the session forward.
home.sizeHint: You can change it while preparing the topics.

steps.themes: You pick the topics to settle: goal, dates, budget…
steps.ideas: Everyone suggests ideas and votes for or against, without anyone knowing who voted what.
steps.recap: The recap keeps the ideas the group agrees on, and we go for another round if needed.

join.title: {host} invites you to “{name}”
join.subtitle: What's your first name?
join.seats: {count, plural, =0 {No participants yet} one {# participant} other {# participants}} out of {max}
join.full: All {max} seats are taken. Ask {host} whether someone can give you theirs.
join.closed: This session is over: everything is decided.

expired.title: This session is no longer available
expired.body: Sessions stay online for {days} days. Create a new one to pick up where you left off.

notFound.title: Session not found
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete. Ask the person hosting the session to send it again.

room.linkCopied: Link copied, you can share it with the group
room.linkCopyFailed: Couldn't copy the link: copy it from the address bar.
room.inviteDescription: {count, plural, one {# seat left. Scan the QR code or send the link.} other {# seats left. Scan the QR code or send the link.}}
room.inviteFull: All seats are taken: nobody else can join the session.
room.qrLabel: QR code for the invite link

seats.row: {count, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}} out of {max}
seats.free: Free seat: tap to copy the invite link
seats.makeHostConfirmHint: {name} will run the steps. You stay in the session as a participant.
seats.removeConfirmHint: Their ideas and votes are deleted. {name} can come back with the link if a seat is still free.
seats.leaveConfirmHint: Your ideas and votes are deleted and your seat is freed. You can come back with the link if a seat is still free.

themes.title: What do we need to decide?
themes.hostSubtitle: Add the topics to decide together, then start the ideas.
themes.guestSubtitle: {host} is preparing the topics, and you can suggest some. What comes next will show up here automatically.
themes.suggestHint: Your suggestion stays anonymous: {host} decides whether to add it.
themes.suggestionsHint: Add them to the list or set them aside. Nobody knows who suggested what.
themes.titlePlaceholder: E.g. Which place should we pick?

kindHints.TEXT: Everyone suggests an idea in a few words.
kindHints.DATE_RANGE: Everyone suggests a period: from… to…
kindHints.AMOUNT: Everyone suggests an amount in euros.
kindHints.AMOUNT_RANGE: Everyone suggests a range in euros: between… and…
kindHints.PLACE: Everyone suggests a place: we add a link to the map.
kindHints.CHOICE: You set the options, everyone votes on them.

themes.kindLocked: Ideas have already been suggested: the answer type can no longer change.
themes.optionsHint: Between {min} and {max} options. They become ideas to vote on when the ideas start.
themes.allowOtherIdeasHint: Participants can add their own ideas to the list.
themes.singleChoiceHint: Everyone picks a single option, as for a yes or no question.
themes.singleChoiceLocked: Ideas have already been suggested: this setting can no longer change.
themes.voteLimitHint: Helps the best ideas stand out when there are many: everyone gets the same number of “for” votes in this topic. “Against” votes stay unlimited.
themes.voteLimitBadge: {count, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} per person

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: What do we want to achieve?

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: How much are we ready to spend?

roles.title: Who does what
roles.description: How do we split the tasks?

themes.deleteConfirmHint: {count, plural, one {# idea suggested on this topic will be deleted along with its votes.} other {# ideas suggested on this topic will be deleted along with their votes.}}
themes.allowSelfVoteHint: When off, nobody can vote for or against the ideas they suggested, and such votes already cast are removed.
themes.timerHint: The timer starts when the ideas start. When it ends, nothing is locked: it's a cue to keep the pace.
themes.autoRecap: Go to the recap when time is up
themes.autoRecapHint: Otherwise, the timer is only a cue: you move on when you choose.
themes.sizeHint: {count, plural, one {# person seated} other {# people seated}}: you can't go below that.
themes.startHint: Add at least one topic to get started.

ideas.title: The ideas
ideas.subtitle: Suggest your ideas and vote on everyone else's. Nobody knows who voted what, and you can change your mind until the recap.
ideas.roundSubtitle: Round {round}: we vote again on the ideas we kept, and you can suggest new ones.
ideas.tiebreakSubtitle: Round {round}, tiebreak: we only vote again on the ideas tied for first. No new ideas during this round.
ideas.autoRecapNotice: When time is up, we move on to the recap.
ideas.empty: No ideas here yet. Who goes first?
ideas.singleChoiceHint: One answer per person: pick the one you prefer.
ideas.votesLeft: {left, plural, =0 {All your “for” votes are used} one {# “for” vote left out of {max}} other {# “for” votes left out of {max}}}
ideas.voteLimitReached: You've used all your “for” votes in this topic: remove one to vote for another idea.
ideas.placePlaceholder: An address or a place name…
ideas.placeHint: We add a link to the map.
ideas.editHint: Votes already cast on it will be removed.
ideas.deleteConfirmHint: The votes already cast on it go with it.
ideas.selfVoteDisabled: Voting on your own ideas is turned off.
ideas.myVotesLeft: {count, plural, one {# idea left without your vote} other {# ideas left without your vote}}
ideas.voteProgress: {done, plural, =0 {Nobody has voted yet} one {# person out of {total} has voted} other {# people out of {total} have voted}}
ideas.backToThemesHint: Everyone goes back to the topics page. Ideas and votes are kept, but deleting a topic also deletes its ideas.

recap.title: The recap
recap.closedBody: The session is over. You can review and export the recap while it stays online.
recap.dateBestDetail: Shared by {count} of the {total} periods kept.
recap.amountBestDetail: Shared by {count} of the {total} ranges kept.
recap.overviewDays: Days covered by the periods kept
recap.overviewAmounts: Ranges kept on the same scale
recap.requireNetPositiveHint: On: an idea is kept if it has more “for” than “against” votes. Off: a single “for” is enough.
recap.reopenConfirmHint: Everyone goes back to the ideas, with their votes, and can change them.
recap.nextRoundHint: {count, plural, =0 {No idea kept: only new ideas will be up for a vote.} one {# idea kept goes back to the vote, and everyone can suggest new ones.} other {# ideas kept go back to the vote, and everyone can suggest new ones.}}
recap.nextRoundConfirmHint: Dropped ideas leave the race and votes start from zero.
recap.tiesNotice: {count, plural, one {# topic has ideas tied for first.} other {# topics have ideas tied for first.}}
recap.tiebreakHint: We only vote again on the ideas tied for first.
recap.tiebreakConfirmHint: In each topic, only the leading ideas stay: the tied ones, or the winning idea if there's no tie. Votes start from zero and no idea can be added.
recap.closeConfirmHint: Once the session is over, nobody can suggest or vote anymore.
recap.waitingHost: {host} is choosing what's next: a new round, or we stop here.

present.fullscreenHint: Click or press a key to go full screen
present.lobbyNote: {host} is preparing the topics. Scan the code to join.
present.seats: {count, plural, one {# seat out of {max} taken} other {# seats out of {max} taken}}
present.topicsNote: The ideas start when {host} moves on
present.ideaCount: {count, plural, =0 {No ideas yet} one {# idea} other {# ideas}}
present.noneKept: No idea kept on this topic
present.more: {count, plural, one {+ # more idea} other {+ # more ideas}}
present.dialogDescription: For a group in the same room: a TV or a projector shows the session, never who suggested what. It takes no seat.
present.step1: On the big screen, open this address:
present.paired: A screen is showing the session
present.pairedHint: It follows each step by itself. You keep the controls here.
present.unpairConfirmHint: It goes back to the code screen: you can pair it again with a new code.

pair.title: Show a session on this screen
pair.description: On the phone of the person hosting, “Show on a big screen” gives a code. Type it here.

export.markdownHint: To paste into Notion, a note or a message
export.csvHint: To open in Excel or Google Sheets

errors.invalidInput: Check what you entered: a field is empty or too long.
errors.roomExpired: This session is no longer online.
errors.sizeBelowParticipants: There are already more people seated than that.
errors.pseudoTaken: This first name is already taken in the group. Add an initial, for example “Lea M.”.
errors.notHost: Only the person hosting the session can do that.
errors.wrongPhase: The session has moved to another step. The page is about to update.
errors.tooManyThemes: You've reached the maximum number of topics.
errors.ideaNotFound: This idea is no longer available.
errors.notAuthor: You can only remove your own ideas from the current round.
errors.selfVoteForbidden: Voting on your own ideas is turned off.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidDateRange: The end date must be the same day as the start date or later.
errors.invalidAmountRange: The second amount must be greater than or equal to the first.
errors.themeKindLocked: Ideas have already been suggested on this topic: its answer type can no longer change.
errors.duplicateIdea: This idea is already suggested in this topic: you can vote for it.
errors.tiebreakNoNewIdeas: This is a tiebreak round: we only vote again on the tied ideas, with no new ideas.
errors.noTies: No tie to break in this round.
errors.participantNotFound: This person is no longer in the session.
errors.cannotTargetSelf: You can't do that on your own seat.
errors.invalidOptions: A list needs between 2 and 10 options, all different.
errors.choiceClosed: This topic is a list: we vote on the options provided.
errors.tooManyRequests: You're going a bit fast. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.hostCannotLeave: Hand over hosting to someone else before leaving the session.
errors.tooManySuggestions: You already have several suggestions waiting: wait until some are handled.
errors.duplicateTheme: This topic is already in the list or already suggested.
errors.suggestionNotFound: This suggestion has already been handled.
errors.voteLimitReached: You've used all your “for” votes in this topic: remove one to vote for another idea.
errors.invalidScreenCode: This code doesn't work: it may have expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.themeInPastRounds: This topic is in the recaps of earlier rounds: it can no longer be deleted.
errors.voteLimitBelowUsed: Some people have already cast more “for” votes than that in this topic: choose a higher limit.
errors.editWindowOver: This idea can no longer be changed: you can remove it and suggest another one.

releaseNotes.description: What changed in Virgule, version by version.
